data.gender_notes: Harned is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'harn', meaning 'strong' or 'hardy'. The name Harned may have been used to describe a brave warrior or a robust farmer in early Germanic societies. The name Harned carries the meaning “Strong, hardy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harned usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, hardy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and resilience in the face of adversity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harned total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
